Required: at least one Exa API call in the project's main loop, a repo link pointing to where Exa is called, and a demo that shows what the system found through Exa and how it used it. Required: README section 'past.dev challenge' with headings Agents, Layers, Results, Caveats, and in the demo one read in which an agent uses data from a different agent.
